chunks: (And) said: "Go down hence together, one the enemy of the other. Then will guidance come to you from Me; and whoever follows My direction will neither be disgraced nor be miserable."
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Go down hence together' in Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse marks the transition from the primordial state of ease to the earthly realm of trial, where Satan becomes a clear enemy to humanity. The promise of 'hudan' (guidance) is interpreted not merely as general revelation but as the specific guidance of the Imams and the Prophet, ensuring that those who follow it remain on the path of felicity. This establishes the theological basis for the necessity of divine leadership (Imamate) as the safeguard against spiritual misguidance and misery.
